result.summary: This PR adds four new functional test cases to feature_torcontrol.py covering the Tor control HASHEDPASSWORD authentication method: correct password success, incorrect password failure, absent -torpassword, and server not advertising HASHEDPASSWORD support. It extends the existing MockTorControlServer to simulate HASHEDPASSWORD PROTOCOLINFO responses. It is a tests-only change touching a single file.
result.problem: The functional test suite does not currently exercise the HASHEDPASSWORD authentication path in Bitcoin Core's Tor controller, so regressions in that code (malformed AUTHENTICATE commands, broken fallback, spurious auth attempts) could go unnoticed by maintainers of the torcontrol module.

resolved_concerns: davidgumberg asked what the wrong-password test verifies beyond the correct-password test; author gave a detailed explanation of the distinct log-check assertion and received no pushback.

result.card: This tests-only PR adds four functional test cases to feature_torcontrol.py covering Tor control's HASHEDPASSWORD authentication method: correct password, wrong password, missing password, and unsupported method. It closes a coverage gap the author states could let 'regressions in tor authentication handling go unnoticed,' such as malformed AUTHENTICATE commands or spurious auth attempts. One reviewer (davidgumberg) questioned the value of the wrong-password test case, and the author gave a detailed, unrebutted explanation. The PR is marked 'Needs rebase' and mergeable_state is dirty after seven force-pushes, with no open substantive objections otherwise. It touches only test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py and has no stated dependencies, though it conflicts with several other open torcontrol-touching PRs (#36260, #36142, #34486).
